skill_outcomes.skill_name: Apply theoretical knowledge to solve real-world problems in businesses

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of current solutions in businesses

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will evaluate the sustainability and scalability of solutions based on various factors including cost, efficiency, and impact on the business environment.

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will adjust system settings based on specific requirements or install updates according to standard procedures of the business.
